aboutCards.title: About me
aboutCards.content:
Creative Designer with 6 years of experience, including 4 years in Web3. Specialized in brand visual identity, 3D visual systems, motion design, and video-based storytelling. Experienced across Layer 1, NFT, DeFi, and cross-chain infrastructure projects, translating complex blockchain narratives into clear, dynamic, and memorable brand experiences.

Currently working at Polyhedra Network, focusing on visual identity and creative direction for product and brand.
